chaining.solution: Four Step tiles in a row.

bend it.solution: Straight line: 4 steps, turn right, 2 steps, bent along the board.

hedge.solution: Straight line: 3 steps, left, 2 steps, left, 3 steps.

resistors.solution: Straight line around the 2x2 block of parts.

more resistors.solution: 21-tile straight line (shortest walk found by BFS) snaked over the board.

out of reach.solution: Two Step tiles pointing at each other: a loop of steps.

stairs.solution: A 4-tile loop: step, left, step, right.

your ad here.solution: An 8-tile loop: 3 steps, left, step, right, step, left.

goodwin.solution: Prefix SSSRSR, then an 8-tile loop SSSSLSRR (the dots repeat with 4-fold symmetry); 28 = shortest walk.

conditionals.solution: Found by local search: a 3-step loop guarded by a wall detector; on a wall, turn right and run 3 extra steps on the way back into the loop.

for.solution: 53-tile straight line (shortest walk) snaked over the 8x8 board; no counters needed.

vertigo.solution: Found by local search: step, turn left, a 6-step loop east along row 1 with a wall detector at its foot; it ends at the hatch in 11 steps (shortest walk is 10).

detector.solution: Found by local search: colour-detector loop.

no turn sign.solution: A 12-tile loop S S L S S S S L S S S L (found by enumerating prefix+loop programs).

++.solution: Five Plus Red tiles, then a step.
grid: pRed> pRed> pRed> pRed> pRed> s> . .

--.solution: Two Minus Red tiles pointing at each other (1 step per decrement); either one steps out when Red is 0. Steps = Red + 2.

:=.solution: 2-tile loop Minus Red / Plus Blue; step out when Red is 0. Steps = 2*Red + 2.

*2.solution: 6-tile loop: (Minus Red, Plus Blue, Plus Blue) twice; either Minus Red steps out at 0. Steps = 3*Red + 2.

+.solution: Loop Minus Red / Plus Yellow, a goto, then loop Minus Blue / Plus Yellow, step. Steps = 2*(Red+Blue) + 4.

/2.solution: 6-tile loop: (Minus Red, Minus Red, Plus Blue) twice; Red is even so only the first Minus of each pair can find 0. Steps = 1.5*Red + 2.

spiral.solution: Wall follower (go until wall, turn left) with multi-step blocks, polished by local search.

warm-up.solution: Three steps to the centre, then a 12-tile loop R S S S S S R R S S S S: each lap turns right at the centre, runs out to an arm end (the fifth step bumps the edge), turns round and runs back.

anywhere.solution: An 18-tile loop that snakes two columns per lap (S x6, L, S, L, S x6, R, S, R); every step is a robot action (48 moves + 12 turns).

way out.solution: Three steps to the bottom tip, then a 14-tile loop (bump, turn round, staircase S R S L S R S L S R S) that walks one quarter of the diamond per lap.

tunnel.solution: Corridor follower (step; at a wall turn left, else right), polished by local search.

labirynth.solution: Right-hand wall follower, polished by local search.

Counting steps.solution: First leg: wall-detector loop that counts its steps with Plus Red; second leg: Minus Red loop spends the count; third leg: plain step loop to the hatch (polished by local search).

zigzag.solution: Corridor follower (step until wall; turn left, or right twice if left is blocked), polished by local search.

x.solution: Found by local search from an empty board: colour-detector loop.

*.solution: Outer loop on Blue; inner 4-tile loops move Red into Yellow+Pink, then Pink into Yellow+Red on the next pass (no copy-back).

/.solution: Repeated subtraction: each pass checks Red (stop at 0), then moves the divisor between Blue and Pink while taking one from Red per unit (4-tile loops), and adds one to Yellow.

hobbit:.solution: Two steps, then a 10-tile loop S S S R S S L S S L (found by enumerating prefix+loop programs); laps sweep the pillar grid diagonally.

just give up.solution: A 10-tile loop S S S L S S L S S L (found by enumerating prefix+loop programs); one-sided walls and bumps steer it through all five parts.

ring of fire.solution: Found by local search from an empty board: wall-detector loop that circles inside the lava ring.

giftwrapped.solution: Found by local search from an empty board: wall and colour detectors steer it round the ribbon.

Fibonacci.solution: Blue := 1, then Red-1 phases that rotate the largest of Blue/Yellow/Pink into the other two (4-tile loops); when Red runs out, move the result into Blue (clearing it first if needed) and step.
